claim: Measured against the pinned header with g++ 14.3.0 at -std=c++20: the epoch instant 1970-01-01 has date::weekday c_encoding 4 (Thursday); z = -4 and z = 3 both have c_encoding 0 (Sunday) and iso_week::weekday 7; z = -5 has c_encoding 6 and iso_week 6; z = -1 has c_encoding 3; z = 4 has c_encoding 1. So the two weekday encodings agree on every instant except where date::weekday is 0, and there iso_week is 7, with the branch boundary of weekday_from_days falling exactly at z = -4 as the source predicts.
